title: Sign up | Bobbin
bodyText: Start turning lessons into insights. Create your free Bobbin account and see how every lesson becomes ready-to-send insights for students, tutors and parents. ● Free trial, no card needed ● AI-powered lesson summaries ● Set up in minutes Create your account You've been referred to Bobbin Get £50 of credit on your Bobbin invoices. After you sign up, apply code ABCDEFGH in Billing. Get started with Bobbin.
